Country-specific information that adds context to the summary indicators above.

</summary>
<div class="country-note-group__body">
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Subnational programme context</h4>
<p>Locality level micro-stratification; 4 categories; API; API categories: low &lt;1; moderate 1–9.99; high 10–49.99; very high ≥50 per 1,000; Most efforts focused in the highest endemic area in the Amazon rainforest, Loreto</p>
</div>
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>High-risk populations</h4>
<p>Mobile populations, miners, loggers, farmers in hard to reach rural populations of the Amazon, especailly in Loreta</p>
</div>
</div>
</details>
<details class="country-note-group">
<summary>

<h4>Diagnostic approach</h4>
<p>Microscopy, RDTs when microscopy is not possible</p>
</div>

<p>PAVE?</p>
